diagnosis.where_you_are: WHAT WE KNOW: Your revenue is about IDR 12 million/month from 3 office subscriptions (IDR 25k per box, minimum 20 boxes per office, Monday to Friday). To reach IDR 25 million you need roughly 5 more offices at the same size. Real demand signals exist: a foundation-network office asked about monthly lunch boxes for around 30 people, said IDR 25k was 'a bit above our budget, we usually get catering at 18-20', and you never followed up for 3-4 months. The logistics office admin said word for word: 'other companies keep asking me who caters your lunches.' WHAT WE DON'T KNOW YET: whether IDR 25k can close NEW offices, whether a lower rate (around 18-20k) still leaves healthy margin per box, and how many of those 'often asking' companies are real and reachable.
diagnosis.primary_constraint: Warm leads are leaking: people already asked about your catering, price was discussed, and you never went back to them. You have at least two live paths (the foundation office and the admin who can introduce you) sitting idle in your WhatsApp, while the plan on the table is to spend IDR 5 million on TikTok ads to find cold strangers.
secondary_constraints: You also have no written offer or catalog (everything lives in chat history and gallery photos), so even a reply today has nothing clean to send. And your demand volume is unproven for the target: 3 offices today, and only one documented past inquiry, is not yet enough pipeline for 5 new offices in 60 days.
why: The evidence converges on follow-up failure: the foundation office asked, heard your price, went quiet, and you said 'I never followed up because I was busy in the kitchen' three to four months ago. The admin said companies keep asking, and you said 'I can ask her to introduce me, she seems willing, I just never made it a real request.' These are the closest, warmest buyers you have, and they cost IDR 0 to reopen. Running ads before testing whether existing leads convert at any price would pay to fill a bucket that is currently leaking.
diagnosis.do_not: 🟡 TEST FIRST — jangan scale, uji kecil dulu — Don't scale how you win clients yet, and don't test volume at the same time as fixing conversion. Do it in 4 phases: (1) fix price response on the leads you have, (2) measure how many inquiries become deals, (3) then run a controlled test with about 10 targeted prospects, (4) then judge whether the target is feasible — Alasan: A test is not scale, and an order is not parallel. If fixing conversion and testing volume run together and fail, you cannot tell why (price? ideal client? demand?). First close the leak on the live leads you already have, measure, then add volume — Berlaku sampai: Each phase passes before the next: phases 1 and 2 until conversion is measured, phase 3 until at least 1 deal closes from the small test, phase 4 judges whether the target is realistic

diagnosis.next_best_action: Run a 7-day follow-up test on the two warm paths already in your WhatsApp, and hold the IDR 5 million ad budget until the results are in. Path 1: return to the foundation-network office with a concrete option at the price band they named (18-20k per box) framed as a limited trial, so you learn whether that rate closes them and whether the margin still works. Path 2: make a real ask to the logistics office admin for introductions to the companies that keep asking her. Every reply, objection, or 'no' tells you what new offices actually need to hear before any ad money is spent.
diagnosis.first_step_today: Open WhatsApp, find the chat with the foundation-network office contact, and send the follow-up message below (adapt the wording so it sounds like you). Under 30 minutes, using only what you already have.

day_by_day.text: Day 1: Send the follow-up message to the foundation-network office contact with a concrete option at 18-20k per box for their ~30 people.
Day 2: Message the logistics office admin and make the real ask: introduce me to 1-2 of the companies that keep asking you.

Day 3: Write your one-page offer (daily rice box, 25k per box, Mon-Fri, minimum 20 boxes per office, about 2.5 million per person per month) plus the discounted-trial variant, so any reply gets an instant answer.

diagnosis.outreach_script:
Follow-up to the foundation-network office: 'Hi, hope you're doing well. A few months back we talked about monthly lunch boxes for your team of about 30, and you mentioned our 25k rate was a bit above budget since you usually pay 18-20. I've been thinking about it, and I'd like to make it work. For a first month I can offer [18k or 20k] per box, Monday to Friday, delivered before lunch, menu rotating weekly, minimum [25/30] boxes a day. If it goes well for both sides we can talk about a longer arrangement. Would you like to try it for one month?'

Ask to the logistics office admin: 'Hi, you once told me other companies keep asking who caters your lunches. Could you introduce me to one or two of them? Just a WhatsApp intro is enough, I'll handle the rest. If one of them signs up, lunch is on me for you and your team for a week as a thank you.'
diagnosis.success_metric: Within 7 days: at least 1 substantive reply from the foundation office (not just 'ok'), at least 1 real introduction name from the admin, and progress on the ladder: price discussed, then a trial commitment from at least 1 new office within 30 days. One reply alone is not success; a signed trial office is.
diagnosis.well_know_when: You will know you learned something no matter how it goes. If the foundation office accepts 18-20k: you learned your 25k price was the blocker for this segment and you have a new revenue line, check the margin per box carefully. If they counter lower than you can serve: you learned this segment cannot pay enough, and ads targeting other office types look better. If they go silent again: you learned this lead is dead and the real path is the admin introductions. If the admin gives you 2+ names: you learned referral through admins is your cheapest channel and worth repeating with all 3 offices. If she stalls too: you learned warm intros are not automatic and ads deserve the budget sooner. Any outcome moves your IDR 25 million plan forward with facts instead of guesses.
diagnosis.pivot_rule: If after 14 days neither path produces a concrete next step (no reply, no introduction names), stop waiting on warm leads and reallocate IDR 5 million to the TikTok ad test, but only with your written one-page offer and a clear price ready, so ad-driven inquiries do not leak the same way.

summary: You run a daily rice box catering service with about IDR 12 million a month from 3 offices, at IDR 25k per box. Your goal is IDR 25 million within 60 days. Your subscriptions run Monday to Friday, minimum 20 boxes per office.

What stands out: an office from the foundation's network asked about lunch boxes, felt IDR 25k was above their 18 to 20 budget, and you never followed up. That warm chat sits idle in your WhatsApp. We do not yet know whether IDR 25k can close new offices.
Because of that unknown, the first step is small on purpose: reopen that chat before spending your IDR 5 million ad budget.

diagnosis.where_you_are: WHAT WE KNOW: Your revenue is about IDR 12 million/month from 3 office subscriptions (IDR 25k per box, minimum 20 boxes per office, Monday to Friday). To reach IDR 25 million you need roughly 5 more offices at the same size. Real demand signals exist: a foundation-network office asked about monthly lunch boxes for around 30 people, said IDR 25k was 'a bit above our budget, we usually get catering at 18-20', and you never followed up for 3-4 months. The logistics office admin said word for word: 'other companies keep asking me who caters your lunches.' WHAT WE DON'T KNOW YET: whether IDR 25k can close NEW offices, whether a lower rate (around 18-20k) still leaves healthy margin per box, and how many of those 'often asking' companies are real and reachable.
diagnosis.primary_constraint: Warm leads are leaking: people already asked about your catering, price was discussed, and you never went back to them. You have at least two live paths (the foundation office and the admin who can introduce you) sitting idle in your WhatsApp, while the plan on the table is to spend IDR 5 million on TikTok ads to find cold strangers.
secondary_constraints: You also have no written offer or catalog (everything lives in chat history and gallery photos), so even a reply today has nothing clean to send. And your demand volume is unproven for the target: 3 offices today, and only one documented past inquiry, is not yet enough pipeline for 5 new offices in 60 days.
why: The evidence converges on follow-up failure: the foundation office asked, heard your price, went quiet, and you said 'I never followed up because I was busy in the kitchen' three to four months ago. The admin said companies keep asking, and you said 'I can ask her to introduce me, she seems willing, I just never made it a real request.' These are the closest, warmest buyers you have, and they cost IDR 0 to reopen. Running ads before testing whether existing leads convert at any price would pay to fill a bucket that is currently leaking.
diagnosis.do_not: 🟡 TEST FIRST — jangan scale, uji kecil dulu — Don't scale how you win clients yet, and don't test volume at the same time as fixing conversion. Do it in 4 phases: (1) fix price response on the leads you have, (2) measure how many inquiries become deals, (3) then run a controlled test with about 10 targeted prospects, (4) then judge whether the target is feasible — Alasan: A test is not scale, and an order is not parallel. If fixing conversion and testing volume run together and fail, you cannot tell why (price? ideal client? demand?). First close the leak on the live leads you already have, measure, then add volume — Berlaku sampai: Each phase passes before the next: phases 1 and 2 until conversion is measured, phase 3 until at least 1 deal closes from the small test, phase 4 judges whether the target is realistic

diagnosis.outreach_script:
Follow-up to the foundation-network office: 'Hi, hope you're doing well. A few months back we talked about monthly lunch boxes for your team of about 30, and you mentioned our 25k rate was a bit above budget since you usually pay 18-20. I've been thinking about it, and I'd like to make it work. For a first month I can offer [18k or 20k] per box, Monday to Friday, delivered before lunch, menu rotating weekly, minimum [25/30] boxes a day. If it goes well for both sides we can talk about a longer arrangement. Would you like to try it for one month?'

Ask to the logistics office admin: 'Hi, you once told me other companies keep asking who caters your lunches. Could you introduce me to one or two of them? Just a WhatsApp intro is enough, I'll handle the rest. If one of them signs up, lunch is on me for you and your team for a week as a thank you.'
diagnosis.success_metric: Within 7 days: at least 1 substantive reply from the foundation office (not just 'ok'), at least 1 real introduction name from the admin, and progress on the ladder: price discussed, then a trial commitment from at least 1 new office within 30 days. One reply alone is not success; a signed trial office is.
diagnosis.well_know_when: You will know you learned something no matter how it goes. If the foundation office accepts 18-20k: you learned your 25k price was the blocker for this segment and you have a new revenue line, check the margin per box carefully. If they counter lower than you can serve: you learned this segment cannot pay enough, and ads targeting other office types look better. If they go silent again: you learned this lead is dead and the real path is the admin introductions. If the admin gives you 2+ names: you learned referral through admins is your cheapest channel and worth repeating with all 3 offices. If she stalls too: you learned warm intros are not automatic and ads deserve the budget sooner. Any outcome moves your IDR 25 million plan forward with facts instead of guesses.
diagnosis.pivot_rule: If after 14 days neither path produces a concrete next step (no reply, no introduction names), stop waiting on warm leads and reallocate IDR 5 million to the TikTok ad test, but only with your written one-page offer and a clear price ready, so ad-driven inquiries do not leak the same way.
